in_english.name: Ulyaa
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ulyaa originates from the Arabic root 'ʿ-l-w', signifying elevation, high rank, and nobility. Referenced in the Quran (17:33), it symbolizes spiritual and moral excellence. Historically significant in Islamic tradition, Ulyaa connotes a person of high moral stature and dignity. The name is used across Muslim cultures, reflecting a universal aspiration for elevated character
